method.matching: same action + same grade + any shared theme, fallback to grade/action/theme components
method.note: V2 candidates are compared only with V2 history. V1/unversioned history is retained but never used as same-condition reference.

summary.note: Reference quality is best when same-profile samples are available; otherwise component fallback is used.
